annotations.title: Check an asking price or rent

description: Compares an asking price or rent against the fair range from real closed deals in the same segment.

area.description: Area name or slug: any of the Dubai areas from list_areas, e.g. "Dubai Marina", "jumeirah-village-circle", "JVC" or "Jumeirah Park".

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms: 0-10, or "studio" (= 0). Give bedrooms or layout.

bua_sqft.description: Built-up area in sqft (villas and townhouses).

building.description: Building name as registered with DLD (apartments), e.g. "Marina Gate 1". Optional: compares with the building when DLD has 6+ ready sales of that type in it in 12 months.

layout.description: Segment key from get_area_snapshot. Give bedrooms or layout.

plot_sqft.description: Plot size in sqft (villas and townhouses).

price_aed.description: Asking price in AED, or annual rent in AED when intent is rent.

size_sqft.description: Size in sqft: unit area for apartments, built-up area (BUA) for villas and townhouses.

name: check_price
title: Check an asking price or rent
